title: Admin Web V2 Users Access Readiness
problem: Admin Web V2 needs a truthful users, roles, and Library Access surface, but Nako currently only has Single-Admin Mode and a stable local-admin principal.
gates: cd apps/admin-web && npm run generate:admin-api && npm run test -- adminApi/client.test.ts adminApi/dataSource.test.ts App.test.tsx && npm run check && npm run build
Browser smoke for /access desktop and mobile

evidence.summary: Confirmed the current boundary: Single-Admin Mode and local-admin principal exist; account, Role, and per-library Library Access policy stores are follow-ons.
Added GET /admin/v1/access/summary, generated Admin Web contract route/types, HTTP docs, and focused server coverage for redaction-safe Single-Admin Mode effective Library Access.
Added Admin Web /access with AdminApiClient/AdminDataSource support, mock fallback, route nav, responsive styling, and route/data-source/client tests.
Ran focused and broad gates, formatting, generated contract parity, Admin Web build/test/check, JSON validity, whitespace checks, and browser desktop/mobile plus intercepted-live smoke.

continue_policy.notes: This readiness lane is complete. Follow-on account/RBAC/Library Access policy mutation work must be opened as a new backend-authority lane before Admin Web adds edit controls.
